author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily README update: Latest News and star history. Recent Apps is refreshed when an app is published.

gist.headline: The garden log grows
gist.blurb: The README has fresh Latest News and updated star-history charts. Even the garden log gets a daily watering.
gist.summary: The September 28 README refresh updates Latest News and the dark- and light-theme GitHub star-history charts so repository visitors can catch up at a glance.
gist.impact: Visitors can see the latest project news and updated star-history charts directly in the README.
gist.visual_concept: Polli tends a small code-garden beside an open README, with a gently rising star-history chart shown on two little retro screens for light and dark themes. Her tiny librarian glasses make the routine update feel like keeping a garden journal.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli adjusts an open README beside two small retro screens showing gently rising star-history charts, while lime green (#ecf874) code-plants bloom nearby. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny librarian glasses, stays small-to-medium sized, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, and the nostalgic warmth of Stardew Valley or A Short Hike.
